defaults.require_approval_message: Shell command requires approval under Kyberion governance.
defaults.deny_message: Shell command is explicitly blocked by Kyberion governance.

allowlist.reason: Read-only shell inspection is allowed. Env-var prefixes and wrapper commands (env, timeout, …) are stripped by de-obfuscation before matching (QM-05).
Pure read-only filters so ordinary pipelines (ls | wc -l, git log | jq) stay allowlisted; write-capable forms (sort -o) are rejected by the allow-path arg guards (QM-05).
Test and lint commands are allowed. Patterns stay within the safe-regex subset (no nested repetition; QM-05).
Mobile AI-DLC/SDLC toolchain (E2E-05): build/test/device ops are allowed; deploy/signing stays approval-gated via the deployment adapter.

MP-04 visual review rasterizes a rendered artifact locally so it can be inspected. Headless conversion only, with an isolated LibreOffice profile; the binaries read the artifact and write page images, and never reach the network. Interactive/non-headless invocations stay approval-gated.

denylist.reason: Recursive destructive deletion is blocked in any flag order or clustering (-rf, -fr, -rfv, -r -f, --recursive --force). Flag clusters must follow whitespace so hyphenated filenames cannot false-match; the boundary class catches payloads inside quotes because deny scans the raw text (QM-05).
Piping untrusted output into a shell is blocked (bare and path-qualified shells).
Disk and filesystem destructive tools are blocked.
Eval/exec style shell execution is blocked.
Base64 decode is blocked when used as shell obfuscation.

Reading office / PDF files by hand (unzip, pdftotext, python-docx, …) is blocked — use the actuator: `pnpm kyberion read <file> [--ocr]` (Markdown on stdout, `--json` for structure), or `pnpm ingest --tenant <slug> --file <file> [--ocr]` to land tenant knowledge. Copy external files into active/shared/tmp/<job>/ first. See knowledge/product/orchestration/document-file-reading-playbook.md.

Perceiving media by hand (tesseract, whisper, ffmpeg frame dumps, pytesseract / cv2 scripts, …) is blocked — use the perception commands: `pnpm kyberion see <image>` (local OCR, `--describe`), `pnpm kyberion listen <audio>` (speech-to-text, `--timestamps`), `pnpm kyberion watch <video>` (keyframe OCR + transcript), `pnpm kyberion read <file>` (pdf/office/html/md). Copy external files into active/shared/tmp/<job>/ first. See knowledge/product/orchestration/perception-playbook.md.

Automating the GUI or speaking by hand (osascript, cliclick, xdotool, screencapture, say, pyautogui / pynput, ad-hoc Playwright) is blocked — the governed executors apply redaction and approval: web page → browser-actuator (`pnpm kyberion browser run`), desktop app / OS → system-actuator `computer_interaction`, screen capture → `system:screenshot`, speech → `pnpm kyberion speak <text> [--out <file>]`. See knowledge/product/orchestration/action-playbook.md.
